github_execution_safety.existing_workflow_risk: The current HTML workflow enforces v1.2 copy-contract identifiers and can auto-commit generated changes across HTML files. Triggering it from a Growth HTML edit would violate current NeoFort authority and the user's single-page mutation scope.
github_execution_safety.safe_action: Do not mutate Growth HTML on main in this execution. Persist the Growth contract/audit and a non-writing, Growth-scoped CI validator first.

final_decision.reason: Topology is structurally admissible, but form fidelity, current-policy identity, formal evidence admission, exact selector/XPath binding and three-replica judge predicates are not all PASS.
